name: Zilpah
overview: Zilpah, introduced as Leah's handmaid given to her by Laban, became an important figure in the Genesis narrative by bearing two sons, Gad and Asher, through Jacob. When Leah ceased bearing children, she gave Zilpah to Jacob, resulting in the birth of Gad, whose name means 'a troop,' and Asher, meaning 'happy,' reflecting Leah's hope for blessing through her handmaid's offspring. These events highlight God's providential care in expanding Jacob's family and fulfilling His covenant promises despite human circumstances.
